verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms llms.txt is live (HTTP 200) at docs.browser-use.com and describes both the Cloud APIs and the open-source library. The docs also point to a managed llms-full.txt bundle under .well-known, and pages are served as .md files, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The managed full bundle is https://docs.browser-use.com/.well-known/llms-full.txt and can be cached for up to 24 hours.
docs.browser-use.com/llms.txt lists "## OpenAPI Specs" with /cloud/openapi/v2.json, v3.json and v4.json.
